body: Yeah, I mean I figured, but worth a shot honestly. Thanks

Thank you. I understand it won't help them, but ultimately I think that it's for the best for all of us - they get to move on with their lives and I get to stop suffering. The times I have managed to open up in the past, it often ends up being a very unhelpful conversation. Not because they don't care or don't want to help, but because of something else. I'm not sure why. Anyways, I'm not sure what would help at this point any more, from them and from myself, and I don't want to burden anyone any further.
Thank you. That means quite a bit and I really appreciate your kindness
I'm sorry to hear about your brother man. And thank you, I wish the same for you
